mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ccds_key_unit (station_id, name, address, category, contact, phone_cipher, notes, plan_text) VALUES (#{stationId}, #{name}, #{address}, #{category}, #{contact}, #{phoneCipher}, #{notes}, #{planText})
mapper.update: UPDATE ccds_key_unit SET plan_text = #{planText}, gmt_modified = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL

UPDATE ccds_key_unit SET station_id = #{stationId}, name = #{name}, address = #{address}, category = #{category}, contact = #{contact}, phone_cipher = #{phoneCipher}, notes = #{notes}, plan_text = #{planText}, gmt_modified = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE ccds_key_unit SET deleted_at = #{deletedAt}, gmt_modified = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT id, station_id, name, address, category, contact, phone_cipher, notes, plan_text, gmt_create, gmt_modified, deleted_at FROM ccds_key_unit WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, station_id, name, address, category, contact, phone_cipher, notes, plan_text, gmt_create, gmt_modified, deleted_at FROM ccds_key_unit WHERE station_id = #{stationId} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY gmt_modified DESC

SELECT id, station_id, name, address, category, contact, phone_cipher, notes, plan_text, gmt_create, gmt_modified, deleted_at FROM ccds_key_unit WHERE station_id = #{stationId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
AND category = #{category}
AND name LIKE CONCAT(#{keyword}, '%') ESCAPE '\\'
ORDER BY gmt_modified DESC

SELECT id, station_id, name, address, category, contact, phone_cipher, notes, plan_text, gmt_create, gmt_modified, deleted_at FROM ccds_key_unit WHERE station_id = #{stationId} AND category = #{category} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY gmt_modified DESC

SELECT id, station_id, name, address, category, contact, phone_cipher, notes, plan_text, gmt_create, gmt_modified, deleted_at FROM ccds_key_unit WHERE station_id = #{stationId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND name LIKE CONCAT(#{keyword}, '%') ESCAPE '\\' ORDER BY gmt_modified DESC
